title: Stillwater Flea Market
story:
The Sleigh Find

Andy spotted the old sleigh sitting off to the side where most people had already walked past it. Weathered wood, worn metal runners, and just enough age to make it interesting.

It wasn’t perfect — which is probably why Andy liked it.

He looked it over, imagined it cleaned up, decorated for winter, or hanging on the wall of a cabin, and decided it deserved one more trip.

So now it’s headed with Andy to the Stillwater Flea Market.

That’s the fun of Smith & Found: sometimes the best finds are the things everyone else almost missed.
